description:
Excellent value-add opportunity in a prime Encino location. This home sits on a generous lot (large backyard!) offering great potential for expansion, ideal for an ADU, junior ADU, or additional living space (buyers to verify). The property is ready for your vision...you can update it, expand on it, or reimagine it to suit your specific needs.

Priced to sell quickly, this is a rare chance for investors, builders, or owner-users looking to create long-term value. Centrally located with convenient access to transportation, shopping, grocery stores, houses of worship, and nearby freeway access.

Opportunities like this, with size, location, and upside, are increasingly hard to find.  Blink and you'll miss it!  Properties with this kind of potential and pricing do not last.  Photos were taken previously and, while dated, remain generally representative of the property’s current visual condition.
